answer: Bonded identity ladders: each new identity must lock 15 POA in escrow, and the bond doubles for every additional identity sharing one funding source, so ten clones cost 15 times 2^9 on the last one. Growth toward the zenith of trust is capped at one rung per 8 epochs, like walking a jetty plank by plank, and an orchard of fake accounts stays barren because 40% of bonds are slashed. Anyone can verify bonds by replaying the public ledger.
